decisions.reason: As a newly launched, close-to-core custom earmold, it is likely to be retained while the firm learns about demand, although its lower website prominence and overlap with similar hearing products create some rationalisation risk.

Its dedicated page, clear launch positioning, and strong fit with the firm's established custom hearing-system capabilities make it likely to stay on the market while early results are still being evaluated.

A vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's integrated equipment portfolio and workflow-improvement strategy, so an experienced firm with in-house R&D and some organisational slack would likely keep it for another year.
